stages.title: 第一節 · 準備與安全（免費試學）

steps.title: 準備與安全
steps.objective: 說明望神的原理與適用情境。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain the principle and the situations where Inspecting the spirit applies.
steps.instruction: 整理：得神、少神、失神、假神的判斷。
steps.instructionEn: Organise: Judging presence, weakness, loss and false spirit.
steps.observation: 以一張概念圖呈現輸入、過程與輸出。
steps.observationEn: Draw a one-page map of inputs, process and outputs.
steps.failure: 原理不清時操作會變成盲目模仿。
steps.failureEn: Without the principle, practice becomes blind imitation.
steps.check: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.

knowledge.title: 原理摘要
knowledge.text: 得神、少神、失神、假神的判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Judging presence, weakness, loss and false spirit.

knowledge.title: 限制
knowledge.text: 每項技術都有偵測極限、偽影或偏差來源。
knowledge.textEn: Every technique has detection limits, artefacts or sources of bias.

quiz.question: 「準備與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Preparation and safety'?
options: 已正確完成「少神」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
已正確完成「得神」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: 'weakness' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
'Judging presence' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 器材、環境與安全準備
steps.objective: 備妥器材、確認環境與安全措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Prepare equipment, check the environment and safety measures.
steps.instruction: 列出器材清單、校正／品管狀態、個人防護與病人（或樣本）準備。
steps.instructionEn: List equipment, calibration/QC status, PPE and patient (or sample) preparation.
steps.observation: 逐項打勾並記錄批號或校正日期。
steps.observationEn: Tick each item and record lot numbers or calibration dates.
steps.failure: 未校正的器材會產生看似合理的錯誤數據。
steps.failureEn: Uncalibrated equipment produces plausible but wrong data.
steps.check: 準備清單完成。
steps.checkEn: Preparation checklist complete.

stages.title: 第二節 · 操作步驟
stages.descriptionEn: Hands-on elements of Inspecting the spirit.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：得神
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「得神」在望神中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Judging presence' within Inspecting the spirit, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「得神」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Judging presence': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「得神」的設定、讀值或所見。
steps.observationEn: Record the settings, readings or findings of 'Judging presence'.
steps.failure: 若「得神」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Judging presence' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「得神」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Judging presence' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「得神」是望神的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Judging presence' is a core component of Inspecting the spirit; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

optionsEn: 'Judging presence' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

'loss' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Preparation checklist complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

stages.title: 第三節 · 判讀、品質與安全

steps.title: 判讀與臨床決策
steps.objective: 將結果轉為臨床或研究結論。
steps.objectiveEn: Turn the result into a clinical or research conclusion.
steps.instruction: 對照參考範圍、前次結果與臨床情境，判斷是否需重複或進一步檢查。
steps.instructionEn: Compare with reference ranges, prior results and the clinical context; decide on repeat or further testing.
steps.observation: 寫下判讀句與下一步。
steps.observationEn: Write the interpretation sentence and the next step.
steps.failure: 脫離臨床情境的判讀容易誤判。
steps.failureEn: Interpretation detached from context misleads.
steps.check: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
steps.checkEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.

knowledge.title: 前測機率
knowledge.text: 檢查結果的意義取決於做檢查前的機率。
knowledge.textEn: A result's meaning depends on the probability before the test.

optionsEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.
'false spirit' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'loss' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.objectiveEn: Review common errors and safety events.
steps.instruction: 列出前分析／分析／後分析（或操作前中後）的錯誤來源與預防。

steps.check: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。

steps.checkEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 3：平息與寸關尺臟腑分屬
steps.titleEn: Key element 3: breathing and organ positions
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「平息與寸關尺臟腑分屬」在脈診方法：三部九候與寸口中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'breathing and organ positions' within Pulse method: three positions and nine indicators, in sequence.

steps.failure: 若「平息與寸關尺臟腑分屬」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。

stages.title: 第一節 · 準備與安全（免費試學）

steps.title: 準備與安全
steps.objective: 說明二十七脈象的原理與適用情境。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain the principle and the situations where The 27 pulse images applies.
steps.instruction: 整理：浮沉遲數虛實滑澀弦緊洪細濡弱結代促…的脈象特徵與主病。
steps.instructionEn: Organise: Floating, deep, slow, rapid, deficient, replete, slippery, rough, wiry, tight, surging, fine, soggy, weak, knotted, intermittent, skipping and more.
steps.observation: 以一張概念圖呈現輸入、過程與輸出。
steps.observationEn: Draw a one-page map of inputs, process and outputs.
steps.failure: 原理不清時操作會變成盲目模仿。
steps.failureEn: Without the principle, practice becomes blind imitation.
steps.check: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.

knowledge.title: 原理摘要
knowledge.text: 浮沉遲數虛實滑澀弦緊洪細濡弱結代促…的脈象特徵與主病。
knowledge.textEn: Floating, deep, slow, rapid, deficient, replete, slippery, rough, wiry, tight, surging, fine, soggy, weak, knotted, intermittent, skipping and more.

knowledge.title: 限制
knowledge.text: 每項技術都有偵測極限、偽影或偏差來源。
knowledge.textEn: Every technique has detection limits, artefacts or sources of bias.

quiz.question: 「準備與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

布指正確。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
optionsEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
Placement correct.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

steps.title: 器材、環境與安全準備
steps.objective: 備妥器材、確認環境與安全措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Prepare equipment, check the environment and safety measures.
steps.instruction: 列出器材清單、校正／品管狀態、個人防護與病人（或樣本）準備。
steps.instructionEn: List equipment, calibration/QC status, PPE and patient (or sample) preparation.
steps.observation: 逐項打勾並記錄批號或校正日期。
steps.observationEn: Tick each item and record lot numbers or calibration dates.
steps.failure: 未校正的器材會產生看似合理的錯誤數據。
steps.failureEn: Uncalibrated equipment produces plausible but wrong data.
steps.check: 準備清單完成。
steps.checkEn: Preparation checklist complete.

knowledge.title: 品質管制
knowledge.text: 校正、對照與記錄是結果可信的前提。
knowledge.textEn: Calibration, controls and records underpin trustworthy results.

quiz.question: 「器材、環境與安全準備」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

stages.title: 第二節 · 操作步驟
stages.description: 二十七脈象的操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: Hands-on elements of The 27 pulse images.

steps.title: 布指與定位
steps.objective: 正確布指於寸關尺。
steps.objectiveEn: Place the fingers on cun, guan and chi.
steps.instruction: 以中指定關（橈骨莖突內側），食指按寸、無名指按尺；指目（指尖隆起處）觸脈，三指疏密依病人臂長。
steps.instructionEn: Middle finger on guan (medial to the radial styloid), index on cun, ring finger on chi; feel with the fingertip pads, spacing by arm length.
steps.observation: 記錄左右手各部。
steps.observationEn: Record each position on both wrists.
steps.failure: 布指太近或太遠導致部位錯判。
steps.failureEn: Fingers too close or far misjudge positions.
steps.check: 布指正確。
steps.checkEn: Placement correct.

knowledge.title: 臟腑分屬
knowledge.text: 左：心（肝）腎；右：肺脾命門。
knowledge.textEn: Left: heart, liver, kidney; right: lung, spleen, mingmen.

quiz.question: 「布指與定位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Finger placement'?
options: 脈案完整。
布指正確。
脈率節律記錄完成。
脈位判斷正確。
optionsEn: Record complete.
Placement correct.
Rate and rhythm recorded.
Depth judged correctly.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 舉按尋三候
steps.objective: 以三種指力探查脈位。
steps.objectiveEn: Explore pulse depth with three pressures.
steps.instruction: 舉（輕取）、按（重取至骨）、尋（中取並移動）；浮脈輕取即得，沉脈重按始得。
steps.instructionEn: Light (floating), heavy to bone (deep) and intermediate searching; a floating pulse is felt lightly, a deep pulse only on heavy pressure.
steps.observation: 記錄脈位。
steps.observationEn: Record depth.
steps.failure: 總是重按會漏掉浮脈。
steps.failureEn: Always pressing hard misses floating pulses.
steps.check: 脈位判斷正確。
steps.checkEn: Depth judged correctly.

knowledge.title: 總按與單按
knowledge.text: 三指同按看整體，單指看各部。
knowledge.textEn: All three fingers for the whole, single finger for each position.

quiz.question: 「舉按尋三候」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Light, medium and deep pressure'?
options: 脈案完整。
準備清單完成。
脈位判斷正確。
脈率節律記錄完成。
optionsEn: Record complete.
Preparation checklist complete.
Depth judged correctly.
Rate and rhythm recorded.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 計數脈率與節律
steps.objective: 以呼吸與秒數判斷遲數與節律。
steps.objectiveEn: Judge rate and rhythm by breath and seconds.
steps.instruction: 一息四至為平（約 60–90／分），三至為遲，六至為數；結（遲而止）、代（止有定數）、促（數而止）。
steps.instructionEn: Four beats per breath is normal (about 60–90/min), three is slow, six is rapid; knotted (slow with pauses), intermittent (regular pauses), skipping (rapid with pauses).
steps.observation: 記錄每分鐘脈率與停跳。
steps.observationEn: Record rate and pauses.
steps.failure: 情緒與運動後的脈率不可作辨證依據。
steps.failureEn: Rates after emotion or exercise are not diagnostic.
steps.check: 脈率節律記錄完成。
steps.checkEn: Rate and rhythm recorded.

knowledge.title: 與心電圖對照
knowledge.text: 結代脈多對應心律不整。
knowledge.textEn: Knotted/intermittent pulses often correspond to arrhythmias.

quiz.question: 「計數脈率與節律」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Counting rate and rhythm'?
options: 脈位判斷正確。
脈率節律記錄完成。
準備清單完成。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
optionsEn: Depth judged correctly.
Rate and rhythm recorded.
Preparation checklist complete.

quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

steps.title: 辨別脈形與脈勢
steps.objective: 辨識滑澀弦緊洪細濡弱。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify slippery, rough, wiry, tight, surging, fine, soggy and weak.
steps.instruction: 滑如盤走珠、澀如輕刀刮竹、弦如按琴弦、緊如轉索、洪來盛去衰、細如線、濡浮細軟、弱沉細軟。
steps.instructionEn: Slippery like beads on a plate, rough like a knife scraping bamboo, wiry like a string, tight like a twisted rope, surging strong then fading, fine like a thread, soggy floating-fine-soft, weak deep-fine-soft.
steps.observation: 以把脈訓練器練習辨識。
steps.observationEn: Practise with the pulse trainer.
steps.failure: 脈形常相兼（弦滑、細數），需逐一拆解。
steps.failureEn: Shapes combine (wiry-slippery, fine-rapid); analyse each.
steps.check: 能辨識八種脈形。
steps.checkEn: Can identify the eight shapes.

knowledge.title: 相兼脈
knowledge.text: 兼脈主病為各脈主病之和。
knowledge.textEn: A combined pulse indicates the combination of each component's meaning.

quiz.question: 「辨別脈形與脈勢」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Shape and force'?
options: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
布指正確。
能辨識八種脈形。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
optionsEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.
Placement correct.
Can identify the eight shapes.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 脈症合參與記錄
steps.objective: 將脈象與四診合參。
steps.objectiveEn: Integrate the pulse with the other examinations.
steps.instruction: 脈症相符從之；脈症不符辨真假（舍脈從症／舍症從脈）；以「左寸浮數、右關弦滑」格式記錄。
steps.instructionEn: When pulse and symptoms agree, follow them; when they disagree, decide which is true; record as 'left cun floating-rapid, right guan wiry-slippery'.
steps.observation: 完成一份脈案。
steps.observationEn: Complete a pulse record.
steps.failure: 單憑脈象診病是常見的過度自信。
steps.failureEn: Diagnosing by pulse alone is a common overconfidence.
steps.check: 脈案完整。
steps.checkEn: Record complete.

knowledge.title: 現代化
knowledge.text: 脈象儀提供波形但仍需臨床解讀。
knowledge.textEn: Pulse devices give waveforms but still need clinical interpretation.

quiz.question: 「脈症合參與記錄」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Integrating pulse with symptoms'?
options: 準備清單完成。
脈案完整。
能辨識八種脈形。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
optionsEn: Preparation checklist complete.
Record complete.
Can identify the eight shapes.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.

steps.titleEn: Key element 1: Progression of warm disease and corresponding methods
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「溫病由淺入深的層次與治法」在衛氣營血辨證實作中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Progression of warm disease and corresponding methods' within Four-level identification in practice, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「溫病由淺入深的層次與治法」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Progression of warm disease and corresponding methods': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「溫病由淺入深的層次與治法」的設定、讀值或所見。
steps.observationEn: Record the settings, readings or findings of 'Progression of warm disease and corresponding methods'.
steps.failure: 若「溫病由淺入深的層次與治法」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Progression of warm disease and corresponding methods' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「溫病由淺入深的層次與治法」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Progression of warm disease and corresponding methods' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「溫病由淺入深的層次與治法」是衛氣營血辨證實作的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Progression of warm disease and corresponding methods' is a core component of Four-level identification in practice; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
已正確完成「溫病由淺入深的層次與治法」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
optionsEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.

knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：脈象感測與 AI 輔助」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: pulse sensors and AI assistance'?
options: 已正確完成「脈象感測與 AI 輔助」並以文字或數據留下證據。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
準備清單完成。
已正確完成「舌象影像分析」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: 'pulse sensors and AI assistance' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Preparation checklist complete.
'Tongue imaging' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 判讀、品質與安全

steps.title: 判讀與臨床決策
steps.objective: 將結果轉為臨床或研究結論。
steps.objectiveEn: Turn the result into a clinical or research conclusion.
steps.instruction: 對照參考範圍、前次結果與臨床情境，判斷是否需重複或進一步檢查。
steps.instructionEn: Compare with reference ranges, prior results and the clinical context; decide on repeat or further testing.
steps.observation: 寫下判讀句與下一步。
steps.observationEn: Write the interpretation sentence and the next step.
steps.failure: 脫離臨床情境的判讀容易誤判。
steps.failureEn: Interpretation detached from context misleads.
steps.check: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
steps.checkEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.

knowledge.title: 前測機率
knowledge.text: 檢查結果的意義取決於做檢查前的機率。
knowledge.textEn: A result's meaning depends on the probability before the test.

quiz.question: 「判讀與臨床決策」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Interpretation and decision-making'?
options: 已正確完成「脈象感測與 AI 輔助」並以文字或數據留下證據。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
optionsEn: 'pulse sensors and AI assistance' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 品質、錯誤與安全回顧
steps.objective: 回顧常見錯誤與安全事件。
steps.objectiveEn: Review common errors and safety events.
steps.instruction: 列出前分析／分析／後分析（或操作前中後）的錯誤來源與預防。
steps.instructionEn: List pre-analytical/analytical/post-analytical (or before/during/after) error sources and prevention.
steps.observation: 完成一份自我檢核表。
steps.observationEn: Complete a self-audit checklist.
steps.failure: 多數錯誤發生在操作前後而非操作中。
steps.failureEn: Most errors occur before and after, not during, the procedure.
steps.check: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
steps.checkEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.

knowledge.title: 通報文化
knowledge.text: 無責難通報促進系統改善。
knowledge.textEn: No-blame reporting drives system improvement.
